book.name: MATTA
book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Akwasamad huraya Yahaya Tǝbaptisǝma a pǝr laɓar Faara a fiya a kaheerha na a chehweed Yahuda,
nagha a ndaarha, “Malaman ɗimiyid nun, ƙǝsǝr Kutǝryid Talara nduwusɗa ɓa.”

content.text: pǝpǝnaman kwaman sarya ɗǝ a ndǝghǝn.’ ”

content: Luwud Yahaya ǝnagha ndan tǝ was thlǝkhmu, ƙǝnanggǝn muwun tǝ paama. Ənnadghǝn mii mbeerha tǝ aam ɗee.
Fiya na a Urshalima tǝ Yahudiya heu tǝ chehweeya kahad na a mii kufad Urdun ɗǝnda thlǝmadghǝn ɗǝ.
Kanda a pǝr ɗimiyid ndan, nagha a ǝnang mbaptisǝma kanda a kufad Urdun.
Amma nana Yahaya Farisaya tǝ Sadukiyaya hangga a ɓarha mbǝɗa ɓa nǝn a ǝnang mbaptisǝma fiya sǝ, ndanggǝn kanda, “Kun huthlingya! Wun ƙǝsgha thlǝmad nun a ɗa sǝsad Faara nun hai na ɓayi?
Ənama ˈya kyadgha ndaarha malangɗun ɗimiyid nun.
A numaɗun ndon kee, ‘Chichid nǝm ni Ibrahim, mbǝ Faara a sǝsang ƙǝm wa.’ Niya ndang nda kun na Faara tǝ sǝsǝmnda ha na a ǝnang wundakhnaya nǝn Ibrahim sǝ tǝ feryini ya.
ˈWanda teena pangnda wurra a kul ɗǝfrha, kala ɗǝfrha mbuwa nggǝtta ngga nanda kyathlang nda ɗǝ muwangganda ahu waarha ɗǝ.
Niyi a ǝnang mbaptisǝma kun tǝ aama. Amma niifa sǝ na ɓayi kalgha nggi mu, tsǝkki na a kwasanggi sahad pahamggǝn hai wa, ndǝghǝnggi ɓanǝn ǝnang mbaptisǝma kun tǝ Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda tǝ waarha.
Nǝghǝn tǝ ɗeng pǝra ha, nǝn a pǝrang ɗiɗiirha ɗǝ ngwanggǝn wan hwalidghǝn ahu ɓirukkun hai. Nǝn a njang nda ɗiɗidghǝn ɗǝ tǝ waarha mbuwa mǝra hai.”
Tǝrgha Yeeso thliigha a Nggalili ɗǝgha kufad Urdun ɗǝ ka a ǝnangga Yahaya mbaptisǝma.
Amma Yahaya karɗafa a ǝnang mbaptisǝma nǝn Yeeso, ndǝghǝn, “Kamɗǝ sani ǝne mbaptisǝma. Kama na ɓarha thlǝmanna ɓa?”
Nggǝmangga Yeeso ndǝghǝn, “Nanǝnya ngwa tsauka kee, ƙǝsǝr kamɗǝ a lǝɗanggǝm ǝngya heu na mid Faara.” Tǝrgha nggǝmngga Yahaya fa.
Hǝrǝm nanda ǝnang mbaptisǝma Yeeso, kyanǝn sǝ ahur aamɗi kee, tǝrgha talara inggaɗǝ na Sǝsǝn Faara nǝn a tǝra hai ƙǝla tǝtiliurha tsauka a tenggǝn.
Sǝk urarha nda a talara hai, “Waana niya, nggǝmni, niyi a tǝk mbǝndǝghǝn fa kaan.”
